captions.detailed: An upright, two-player arcade cabinet in a sleek black finish, featuring a top marquee, a central tilted monitor bay, a wide control deck, and a lower cabinet section. The control deck is equipped with joysticks and multiple colored buttons, including two large start buttons on the left and right. The lower section houses dual coin slots and a dark grey service hatch. The service hatch rotates downward on a bottom-mounted horizontal revolute hinge, while the two start buttons translate prismatically inside their respective guide sleeves.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a two-player upright arcade machine with a black cabinet, a tilted screen, and a detailed control panel. Implement an articulated service hatch at the bottom that rotates on a revolute joint, and two start buttons on the deck that can slide vertically via prismatic joints.
captions.factory: The code constructs the arcade cabinet using a main body box, a marquee header, and a tilted monitor screen. The control deck is built with a base plate, joysticks, and colored button cylinders. A service hatch is modeled as a flat box with a handle, attached to the main cabinet via a revolute articulation at its bottom edge. The two start buttons are modeled as separate cylinder parts, each linked to the control deck with a prismatic joint to allow vertical translation.
